newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani police kills three people in Karachi.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani police kills three people in Karachi.

text.p: Pakistani police shot dead three people in the troubled port city of Karachi on Monday and wounded another in a shoot-out, police said.
They said three armed men were killed in an exchange of fire with the police in the volatile eastern Korangi area, while one man was wounded.
More than 155 people have been killed in Karachi during the last four months compared to more than 500 in 1996 and more than 2,000 in 1995.
